beaches.name: Donauinsel FKK-Bereich Süd (km 2,1–5,1)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathing mix within the marked FKK area on the southern Donauinsel. The City of Vienna (Wiener Gewässer) designates it with 'FKK' ground markings on the left flood dam and the island from km 2,1 to km 5,1 and states that bathers there may be nude or in swimwear. The page asks for discreet conduct from all visitors, clothed and unclothed; the island house rules refer nude sunbathing to the marked FKK areas.

beaches.name: Dechantlacke (Lobau)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is permitted at the Dechantlacke natural bathing place in the Lobau. The City of Vienna's page for the site states 'FKK ist erlaubt' and does not restrict it to a section of the bathing place. The page, maintained by Stadt Wien - Wiener Gewässer and last updated 5 May 2026, lists no enforcement note and marks the site as free of charge.
